```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10)
```

## Load Packages

```{r packages}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(yaml)
library(here)
library(knitr)
```

## Load Data

Reads the yearly files written by `scripts/01 prep/birdnet_combine_year.R`
(`data/processed/birdNET/birdNET_<year>_combined.csv`). These are the raw BirdNET
predictions: nothing has been filtered or verified, so every count below is
"BirdNET said so", not "the bird was there".

```{r load}
cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(here("configs", "project.yml"))
years <- cfg$params$birdnet_years
thresholds <- cfg$params$thresholds

out_dir <- here(cfg$outputs$reports_dir, "birdnet_raw_summary")
fig_dir <- here(cfg$outputs$figures_dir, "birdnet_raw_summary")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

birdnet <- rbindlist(lapply(years, function(yr) {
  fread(here(cfg$paths$birdnet_raw_dir, paste0("birdNET_", yr, "_combined.csv")),
        encoding = "UTF-8")
}), fill = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    Month = factor(month.abb[as.integer(format(Date, "%m"))], levels = month.abb),
    Confidence = as.numeric(Confidence)
  )

# Focal marsh sparrows (BirdNET reports common names, so match on those)
focal <- tibble(
  Code = c("SALS", "NESP", "SESP"),
  Common_Name = c("Saltmarsh Sparrow", "Nelson's Sparrow", "Seaside Sparrow")
)
sparrows <- birdnet %>%
  inner_join(focal, by = "Common_Name") %>%
  mutate(Code = factor(Code, levels = focal$Code))

save_table <- function(df, name) {
  fwrite(df, file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
  df
}
```

Lowest confidence in the data: **`r round(min(birdnet$Confidence, na.rm = TRUE), 2)`**
(BirdNET's minimum-confidence setting at analysis time). Thresholds used below:
`r paste(thresholds, collapse = ", ")` (from `configs/project.yml`).

## 1. Dataset Overview

`Files_With_Detections` only counts audio files where BirdNET predicted at least
one species. It is a lower bound on recording effort, not the total number recorded.

```{r overview}
overview <- birdnet %>%
  group_by(Year, Site, Station) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    Species = n_distinct(Common_Name),
    Files_With_Detections = n_distinct(Audio_File),
    Days_With_Detections = n_distinct(Date),
    First_Date = min(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Last_Date = max(Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Confidence = round(median(Confidence, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  save_table("overview_by_station")
kable(overview, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## 2. Confidence Distribution

Most raw BirdNET predictions sit at low confidence. How many survive each threshold
shows how sensitive any result is to the cutoff you pick.

```{r conf-hist, fig.height=4}
ggplot(birdnet, aes(Confidence)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, boundary = 0, fill = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds, linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "BirdNET confidence", y = "Detections", title = "All species") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r thresholds}
retained <- lapply(c(0, thresholds), function(t) {
  birdnet %>%
    filter(Confidence >= t) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(Threshold = t, Detections = n(), Species = n_distinct(Common_Name), .groups = "drop")
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(Pct_Of_Raw = round(100 * Detections / first(Detections), 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  save_table("detections_by_threshold")
kable(retained, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## 3. Most Detected Species

```{r top-species}
top_species <- birdnet %>%
  group_by(Year, Common_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    Stations = n_distinct(Station),
    Days = n_distinct(Date),
    Median_Confidence = round(median(Confidence), 3),
    Max_Confidence = round(max(Confidence), 3),
    Detections_0.9 = sum(Confidence >= 0.9),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, desc(Detections)) %>%
  save_table("species_summary_all")

top_species %>% group_by(Year) %>% slice_head(n = 25) %>% kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

Species richness (number of species BirdNET reported) per station at each threshold:

```{r richness}
richness <- lapply(c(0, thresholds), function(t) {
  birdnet %>%
    filter(Confidence >= t) %>%
    group_by(Year, Site, Station) %>%
    summarise(Richness = n_distinct(Common_Name), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Threshold = paste0(">=", t))
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Threshold, values_from = Richness, values_fill = 0) %>%
  save_table("richness_by_station_threshold")
kable(richness)
```

## 4. Focal Marsh Sparrows (SALS, NESP, SESP)

### 4a. Detection counts by threshold

```{r sparrow-counts}
sparrow_counts <- lapply(c(0, thresholds), function(t) {
  sparrows %>%
    filter(Confidence >= t) %>%
    count(Year, Site, Station, Code, name = "Detections") %>%
    mutate(Threshold = paste0(">=", t))
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  complete(nesting(Year, Site, Station), Code, Threshold, fill = list(Detections = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Threshold, values_from = Detections) %>%
  arrange(Code, Year, Station) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_detections_by_threshold")
kable(sparrow_counts, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

### 4b. Confidence summary

```{r sparrow-conf}
sparrow_conf <- sparrows %>%
  group_by(Code, Year, Site, Station) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    Min = min(Confidence),
    Q1 = quantile(Confidence, 0.25),
    Median = median(Confidence),
    Mean = mean(Confidence),
    Q3 = quantile(Confidence, 0.75),
    Max = max(Confidence),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(Min:Max, ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_confidence_summary")
kable(sparrow_conf)
```

```{r sparrow-conf-hist, fig.height=6}
p <- ggplot(sparrows, aes(Confidence, fill = Site)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, position = "stack") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = thresholds, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(Code ~ Year, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "BirdNET confidence", y = "Detections") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "sparrow_confidence_hist.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
       height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
p
```

### 4c. Detection days (naive occupancy)

Share of a station's active days (days with any BirdNET detection) on which each
sparrow was detected at least once. Repeat calls on one day can't inflate this
the way raw counts can, so it is usually the more useful number for presence.

```{r sparrow-days}
active_days <- birdnet %>%
  distinct(Year, Site, Station, Date) %>%
  count(Year, Site, Station, name = "Active_Days")

sparrow_days <- lapply(thresholds, function(t) {
  sparrows %>%
    filter(Confidence >= t) %>%
    distinct(Year, Site, Station, Code, Date) %>%
    count(Year, Site, Station, Code, name = "Detection_Days") %>%
    mutate(Threshold = t)
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  complete(nesting(Year, Site, Station), Code, Threshold, fill = list(Detection_Days = 0)) %>%
  left_join(active_days, by = c("Year", "Site", "Station")) %>%
  mutate(Prop_Days = round(Detection_Days / Active_Days, 3)) %>%
  arrange(Code, Threshold, Year, Station) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_detection_days")

sparrow_days %>%
  select(-Detection_Days) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Threshold, values_from = Prop_Days, names_prefix = "Prop_>=") %>%
  kable()
```

### 4d. Seasonal pattern

Daily detections at confidence >= `r thresholds[1]`.

```{r sparrow-daily, fig.height=8}
daily <- sparrows %>%
  filter(Confidence >= thresholds[1]) %>%
  count(Year, Station, Code, Date)
p <- ggplot(daily, aes(Date, n, colour = Station)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(Code ~ Year, scales = "free") +
  labs(y = "Detections per day") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "sparrow_daily_detections.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
       height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
p
```

Detections by month. Nelson's Sparrow is mainly a migrant and winter visitor in New
Jersey (roughly May–early June and late Sept–Oct). NESP predictions in mid-summer
are most likely Saltmarsh Sparrow, which BirdNET often confuses with it.
Check those clips before using them.

```{r sparrow-month}
sparrow_month <- sparrows %>%
  filter(Confidence >= thresholds[1]) %>%
  count(Code, Year, Month) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Month, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_detections_by_month")
kable(sparrow_month)
```

### 4e. Time of day

Hour is taken from the recorder's clock (file name timestamp).

```{r sparrow-hour, fig.height=5}
p <- sparrows %>%
  filter(Confidence >= thresholds[1]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Hour)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_grid(Code ~ Year, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 3)) +
  labs(y = "Detections") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "sparrow_hour_of_day.png"), p, width = cfg$params$width,
       height = cfg$params$height, dpi = cfg$params$dpi)
p
```

### 4f. Overlapping sparrow predictions

These are 3 s segments where BirdNET predicted more than one focal sparrow at once.
Overlaps are a sign of confusion between these species, so they are a good place
to start listening.

```{r sparrow-overlap}
overlap <- sparrows %>%
  group_by(Year, Station, File, Start_s) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Code) > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    Species = paste(sort(as.character(unique(Code))), collapse = "+"),
    Confidences = paste0(Code, "=", round(Confidence, 2), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_overlapping_segments")

overlap %>% count(Year, Species, name = "Segments") %>% kable()
```

## 5. Clips for Manual Verification

These clips let you check BirdNET's precision for each sparrow before choosing a
threshold. For each species and year, up to 10 random clips are drawn from every
0.1-wide confidence bin. Record whether each clip is correct in the `Verified`
column, then plot precision by bin (or fit a logistic regression of
correct ~ confidence) to pick a defensible cutoff.

```{r validation}
set.seed(42)
validation <- sparrows %>%
  mutate(Conf_Bin = cut(Confidence, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Code, Year, Conf_Bin) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Code, Year, Conf_Bin) %>%
  select(Code, Year, Site, Station, Date, Conf_Bin, Confidence, Start_s, End_s, Audio_File, File) %>%
  mutate(Verified = NA_character_, Notes = NA_character_) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_validation_sample")

validation %>% count(Code, Year, Conf_Bin) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Conf_Bin, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kable()
```

Highest-confidence clip for each sparrow at each station (good reference recordings):

```{r best-clips}
best <- sparrows %>%
  group_by(Code, Year, Station) %>%
  slice_max(Confidence, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Code, Year, Station, Date, Confidence, Start_s, End_s, Audio_File) %>%
  save_table("sparrow_top_clips")
kable(best)
```

All tables above are written to `outputs/reports/birdnet_raw_summary/` and the
figures to `outputs/figures/birdnet_raw_summary/`.
